Product Description

The New Balance 608 V5 is a proven favorite for men's cross training shoes that deliver comfort from morning to night. The ABZORB heel crash pad absorbs impact on every step, while a molded PU insert and relaxed fit last provide an underfoot feel that is hard to beat. The sturdy suede upper is supportive and breaks in nicely over time, and lightweight EVA foam with an internal midsole shank adds cushioning and midfoot stability. Dual density collar foam supports the ankle, and the Phantom Liner interior has minimal seaming to reduce irritation. Whether you are at the gym, on a walk, or on your feet all day at work, the 608 V5 keeps you comfortable.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

  • The Accidental Curmudgeon
    5 out of 5 stars
    Support properly, and perform their duty day after day
    Reviewed in the United States on July 19, 2026
    Color: Orca/Gunmetal/OrcaSize: 12 X-Wide
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I wear only New Balance Extra Wide shoes. The explanation is neither mysterious nor flattering: I carry more weight than I ought to, and my feet insist on reminding me. These provide the width I need along with an arch that actually supports rather than merely decorates the insole. In a marketplace increasingly devoted to fashion masquerading as function, that is no small achievement.

    I generally buy the 608 V5 cross trainers because they consistently have the best availability in Extra Wide. That alone earns them a place near the top of my shopping list. They also come in enough colors to satisfy whatever mood strikes you. I've accumulated black, white, brown, blue, and now gunmetal. Evidently, when I find something that works, I become a predictable voter.

    The shoes are comfortable from the first day, supportive during long walks, and forgiving during those moments when the bathroom scale reminds me that arithmetic is undefeated. They have become my everyday footwear, accompanying me through errands, appointments, and the ordinary business of retirement.

    No product is without its legislative amendments. Occasionally the shoelaces seem unnecessarily thick or comically long, as though drafted by a committee unable to agree when to stop. It's hardly a constitutional crisis, but every so often I find myself wondering whether someone at New Balance has a side business selling extra lace.

    Because these are my primary shoes—and because I place a bit more stress on them than their designers probably envisioned—they're generally ready for retirement after about six months. I don't regard that as a defect so much as the inevitable consequence of constant use and a user who could stand to lose a few pounds.

    Institutions endure because they reliably perform their intended function. The same may be said of these shoes. They are not flashy, they make no extravagant promises, and they will not transform your life. They simply fit well, support properly, and perform their duty day after day. In an era of exaggerated marketing claims, there is something refreshingly conservative about a product that succeeds by quietly doing exactly what it was designed to do. Five stars.

    4 out of 5 stars
    A solid durable feeling shoe.
    Reviewed in the United States on July 4, 2026
    Color: White/Team Royal/BlackSize: 12 X-Wide
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Pretty good so far.

    Key point: Don’t order up. Plenty of size in these shoes, and the X wide is working for My Hawaiian feet.

    I got these for power walking and compared to walking in slippers ( My usual) they’ve really upped My game, enabling me to do a 10 min 34 sec. Split time on a 2 mile walk yesterday. Not bad at nearly 64 yrs old.

    I also ordered a couple pair of Sketchers.

    Here’s how they compare.

    The NB is way more substantial, with a harder, no doubt more durable rubber sole, while the Sketchers have a much more soft, almost a foam sole.

    NB has much more support and stabilization, but is not quite as comfortable out of the box as the NB.

    Some of the new balance shoes have an awkward slip on/lacing system. That is very difficult to get snug..

    The NB is lighter due to the flimsier foam soles. Don’t skimp on the width. These tend to run narrow even the extra wide isn’t quite wide enough on one of the models I got.

    Verdict: if you’re simply doing casual walking, perhaps the new balance might fit your needs, but if you’re going to be putting in the miles, like I do at break next speed, you’d probably do better to stick with the new balance.

    I was very reluctant to try New Balance shoes because my now 82 year old father having worn the standard issue NB white shoes for years I couldn’t picture me in those things. Every man over 70 wears them I thought.

    I was subject to foot problems because of a defect in my left foot. My podiatrist told me to try a pair. Maybe get in a different color pattern than dad’s shoes. I loved them instantly. I wear a size 15 shoe and comfort and wearability matters.

    Now that I have owned several pairs of NB shoes I am hooked. My sneaker inventory is down to two pairs that I would have trashed long ago if I only had a replacement. I was prepared to spend up to about $150 for shoes if I wanted. As I was looking through NB shoes first I stumbled across this patriotic looking pair and saw the amazing prize. I ordered them and two days later I have them and they are wonderful as usual. Also just in time for the Fourth of July.

    So happy I may buy a second pair. And with the money I’ve saved buy a different pair as well. The price is too good.

About this Item

  • ABZORB HEEL CUSHIONING - ABZORB heel crash pad absorbs impact on every step, paired with a molded PU insert for underfoot comfort that lasts from morning to night
  • SUEDE LEATHER UPPER - Sturdy suede upper provides supportive structure and a classic look that breaks in nicely over time for a personalized fit
  • DUAL DENSITY COLLAR - Dual density collar foam supports the ankle and helps maintain stability during workouts, walks, and all-day wear
  • PHANTOM LINER INTERIOR - Phantom Liner construction features minimal interior seaming to reduce irritation and create a smooth, comfortable fit against the foot
  • LIGHTWEIGHT EVA FOAM - EVA foam midsole with an internal shank adds lightweight cushioning and midfoot stability for versatile daily comfort

Product Description

Product Description
The New Balance 608 V5 is a proven favorite for men's cross training shoes that deliver comfort from morning to night. The ABZORB heel crash pad absorbs impact on every step, while a molded PU insert and relaxed fit last provide an underfoot feel that is hard to beat. The sturdy suede upper is supportive and breaks in nicely over time, and lightweight EVA foam with an internal midsole shank adds cushioning and midfoot stability. Dual density collar foam supports the ankle, and the Phantom Liner interior has minimal seaming to reduce irritation. Whether you are at the gym, on a walk, or on your feet all day at work, the 608 V5 keeps you comfortable.
From the Manufacturer
New Balance, is dedicated to helping athletes achieve their goals. It's been their mission for more than a century. It's why they don't spend money on celebrity endorsements. They spend it on research and development. It's why they don't design products to fit an image. They design them to fit. New Balance is driven to make the finest shoes for the same reason athletes lace them up: to achieve the very best.
